server.description: The IP hostname of the server.

port.description: The port number on which the web server is listening.

ssl_ciphers.description: List of cipher suites for SSL negotiation, separated by colon.

ssl_no_reuse.description: Do not reuse SSL session IDs.

method.description: HTTP method to use for requests.

uri.description: URI to access on the server.

num_conns.description: Total number of connections to create for request-oriented workloads.

rate.description: Fixed rate at which connections or sessions are created.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for server reaction.

think_timeout.description: Additional time allowed for server to initiate sending reply.

burst_length.description: Length of bursts for session-oriented workloads.

num_calls.description: Total number of calls to issue on each connection.

server_name.description: Server name for the Host header.

hog.description: Use up as many TCP ports as necessary.

failure_status.description: HTTP status code to treat as a failure.

send_buffer.description: Maximum size of socket send buffers.

recv_buffer.description: Maximum size of socket receive buffers.

wlog.description: URI log file configuration in B,F format.

wsess.description: Session workload configuration in N1,N2,X format.

wsesslog.description: Session log workload configuration in N,X,F format.

wset.description: Working set configuration in N,X format.

client.description: Client identity specification in I/N format.
